info.name: AI Resume Analysis & Skill Gap API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for testing all REST endpoints of the AI-Powered Resume Analysis & Skill Gap Detection system.

request.description: Checks server operational status and API documentation URL.
Inspects status of PDF parser (PyMuPDF), DOCX parser, scoring weights, and connected cloud services.

formdata.description: Select a PDF (.pdf) or Word document (.docx) under 10MB

request.description: Validates MIME/magic bytes, parses text, and extracts structured candidate profile via LLM.
Extracts required skills, preferred bonus skills, experience minimums, and education requirements from raw JD text.
Standalone utility calculating matched skills with verified evidence quotes, missing skills, transferable skills, and preferred gaps.

formdata.value: Looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong Python, FastAPI, React, and Docker background. Experience with CI/CD and AWS is a plus. BS in CS required.

request.description: Executes full multi-tier pipeline: parsing -> LLM extraction -> normalization -> gap detection -> 60/15/15/10 scoring -> actionable learning roadmaps -> persistence.
Fetches a full saved analysis report including score meter breakdown, skill gaps, and learning recommendations.
Returns list of all historical resume analyses for the History page comparative view.
